transformation_type.raw_value: thermal decomposition of iron oleate to magnetite nanocrystals
transformation_type.normalized_value: thermal decomposition of iron oleate to magnetite nanocrystals
transformation_type.derivation: Transformation label summarizes the source-described reaction.

operation.raw_value: Stir and degas the mixture on a Schlenk line at 110 °C.
operation.normalized_value: Stir and degas the mixture on a Schlenk line at 110 °C.

operation.raw_value: Place under nitrogen flow and heat from 110 °C to 300 °C at 3.3 °C/min using a temperature controller.
operation.normalized_value: Place under nitrogen flow and heat from 110 °C to 300 °C at 3.3 °C/min using a temperature controller.

time.derivation: Calculated ramp duration: (300 °C - 110 °C) / (3.3 °C/min) = 57.6 min. The paper reports the rate, not a rounded duration.

operation.raw_value: Count reaction time from reaching 300 °C and hold for 1 h under nitrogen flow.
operation.normalized_value: Count reaction time from reaching 300 °C and hold for 1 h under nitrogen flow.

operation.raw_value: Quickly cool the reaction solution to room temperature by blowing air across the flask.
operation.normalized_value: Quickly cool the reaction solution to room temperature by blowing air across the flask.

operation.raw_value: Precipitate the iron-oxide nanocrystals with ethanol and isolate by centrifugation at 5500 × g.
operation.normalized_value: Precipitate the iron-oxide nanocrystals with ethanol and isolate by centrifugation at 5500 × g.

operation.raw_value: Wash with three ethanol precipitation/redispersion cycles, each followed by centrifugation at 5500 × g.
operation.normalized_value: Wash with three ethanol precipitation/redispersion cycles, each followed by centrifugation at 5500 × g.

operation.raw_value: Dry the nanocrystals under vacuum and weigh them.
operation.normalized_value: Dry the nanocrystals under vacuum and weigh them.

operation.raw_value: Redisperse the nanocrystals in n-hexane at 20 mg/mL for further use.
operation.normalized_value: Redisperse the nanocrystals in n-hexane at 20 mg/mL for further use.

reactor.raw_value: 250 mL three-neck round-bottom flask; Schlenk line; temperature controller

original_text.raw_value: Iron oleate (10 mmol, 9.0 g) and oleic acid (5.5 mmol, 1.56 g) ... 1-octadecene:1-tetradecene (40:10 g) ... degassed ... 110 °C for 3 h ... under nitrogen flow ... heated to 300 °C at 3.3 °C/min ... 1 h ... quickly cooled ... precipitated using ethanol ... centrifugation (5500 × g, 20 min) ... three precipitation/redispersion cycles ... dried under vacuum ... redispersed in n-hexane at 20 mg/mL.
original_text.normalized_value: See ordered degassing, ramp, hold, cooling and isolation steps.

addition_order.raw_value: Charge iron oleate and oleic acid into the 1-octadecene/1-tetradecene solvent mixture before degassing.

pretreatment.raw_value: mixture stirred and degassed on a Schlenk line at 110 °C for 3 h

measurement_basis.raw_value: method heading identifies 8 nm magnetite; final material was isolated, dried, weighed and redispersed, but product mass/yield is not reported

notes.raw_value: The source reports a heating rate of 3.3 °C/min from the 110 °C degassing temperature to 300 °C; the corresponding ~57.6 min ramp duration is calculated and marked inferred.
The final product was redispersed at 20 mg/mL, but the source does not report the isolated product mass or chemical yield.

unresolved: No isolated nanocrystal mass or chemical yield is reported.
Iron-oleate precursor composition and decomposition coproducts are unresolved.
The Fe3O4 nanocrystal is heterogeneous and has no unique finite SMILES; Fe-O classification is partial.
The ~57.6 min ramp duration is calculated from the reported rate and endpoints, not directly reported by the authors.
